name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: Self-hosted Git server with CI/CD, code review, issue boards and package registry, backed by a bundled PostgreSQL database.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated ONEDEV_ADMIN_PASSWORD from this app's environment settings. The admin account and server URL are only created on the first start; change the password and email later in OneDev, not in the environment.
The Docker socket is not mounted, so CI/CD jobs cannot run on the server itself. Connect an agent and add a Remote Docker or Remote Shell executor under Administration to run builds.
